description: Example study file for scripts/transfer_analysis.py. Paths are relative to this file. slurm/submit_transfer.sh writes results to $SCRATCH/worldseeds/results/transfer/<model>/; copy this file there and point it at them. static_qa is a covariate: a score that measures raw model strength without agency (e.g. a knowledge benchmark), so the partial correlation asks whether SeedVille predicts more than 'a bigger model is better'.
